id: title:VojtechBartos:give a codex turn one trace id

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a shared utility and configuration to propagate run-level trace IDs into turn-complete notifications, supporting downstream consumers that expect this trace ID. This could aid PostHog's observability and debugging of agent-side workflows, though the specific benefit depends on whether PostHog uses this adapter and expects trace IDs.
review.reason: Adds a new exported function `withTurnTraceId` and its unit tests, along with a configuration option `stampedRunTraceId` to the ACP connection adapter. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the agent-side connection, allowing it to receive and propagate a run-level trace ID. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in the diff.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether PostHog uses this specific adapter and whether downstream consumers require the trace ID. The code does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or adoption, and the connection to PostHog's core reliability or security is not established by the patch alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; only observations are returned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exported function `withTurnTraceId` and its unit tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared utility to inject a run-level trace ID into turn-complete notifications when the adapter does not supply one, supporting downstream consumers that expect a trace ID on the notification.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test suite for `withTurnTraceId`.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests for the new trace-ID injection behavior, including cases where the adapter reports no trace ID and where the header is not stamped.

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option `stampedRunTraceId` to the ACP connection adapter.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the agent-side connection to receive and propagate a run-level trace ID stamped by the gateway, which is then supplied to the `withTurnTraceId` utility.
